title: Exact Spelling For Repair Logo
tests: Preserves an intentionally unusual business spelling and capitalization in the rendered logo.

faults.what: The lettering is white on a large gray rectangle instead of black on the requested white background.
The wrench and name are separated by excessive empty space, making the logo feel disconnected.

judge.summary: The square logo has the correctly spelled name and a small orange wrench, but uses white lettering on a gray panel rather than black lettering on white.

must_haves.item: The rendered name reads exactly 'KwickFixx', preserving spelling and capitalization.
must_haves.why: The name clearly reads KwickFixx, with capital K and F and two final x's.

must_haves.item: The name is legible and not obscured by the mark.
must_haves.why: The lettering is readable and the wrench does not overlap it.

must_haves.item: A small orange wrench accompanies black lettering.
must_haves.why: A small orange wrench is present, but the lettering is white, not black.

must_haves.item: The background is white and there is no slogan or additional text.
must_haves.why: There is no slogan or additional text, but a large gray rectangular background appears behind the name.
